label: Mirror
description: This wall's glass shown on other walls as video, whatever is on it: encoded here, decoded there, in hardware where both ends have it

to.label: Shown on
to.description: The walls that show this one, host or host:wall, by commas; host:wall@WxH/fps gives one its own largest size and frames a second

size.label: Largest size
size.description: The most a wall is sent, never more than its own glass; the source's shape is kept

fps.label: Frames a second
fps.description: How many frames a second the glass is sent at

lead.label: Lead
lead.description: Seconds behind the source each frame is shown, on the walls' clocks; 0 shows each as soon as it is decoded; auto is the most any wall wants, given to all: 0.25, 0.5 from a Mac encoding on VideoToolbox or to a wall decoding on more than two threads, 0.8 above 720p on a Pi 3

codec.label: Codec
codec.description: auto sends each wall what it decodes in hardware, and refuses one that decodes nothing this can send; h264 sends H.264 to any wall that takes it, decoded in software where it must be

bitrate.label: Bitrate
bitrate.description: Mb/s sent to each wall at the size and rate sent; auto is 3 at 720p25, scaled by the pixels a second

pull.label: Pull
pull.description: Run on the host it is started on, a destination's, and encode on the source's host through ssh, so only the encoded stream crosses the network: for a source that cannot reach this host

place.label: Where on them
place.description: auto takes each wall's base where nobody holds it and goes above it where somebody does; above or top a layer over the base; 0 the base itself, taken from whoever holds it
